cases.answer: In the ICD mini-review, surface-exposed CALR (calreticulin) translocates from the ER to the plasma membrane and acts as an 'eat-me' signal for DCs, facilitating phagocytosis of dying tumor cells. Extracellular ATP stimulates the purinergic receptor P2RX7 on DCs, triggering inflammasome activation and secretion of IL-1β and IL-18. HMGB1 released from the nucleus binds TLR4 on DCs, promoting their maturation and antigen-presenting capabilities.

cases.answer: They measure different things. The observational meta-analysis (Sabaté-Ortega et al., 12 studies, NSCLC patients on ICIs) pools the prevalence (3%) and hazard (HR 1.78 vs other drugs) of CV events (a composite of CV toxicity/events, including MACE-type outcomes) as adverse-event incidence. The older-adult SEER-Medicare PD-1i cohort (Kim et al.) instead analyses cause-specific mortality, i.e. deaths from CVD as one competing cause (2.80% of 3746 deaths) using Fine-Gray competing-risks sub-distribution HRs, only among PD-1i-treated patients aged ≥65 with advanced NSCLC, with no non-ICI comparator (the PD-1i comparison is nivolumab vs pembrolizumab, sHR 1.08). So event incidence/hazard versus CVD death as a competing-risk outcome are different endpoints and populations.

cases.answer: No Basque Country FIT programme dual-screening rate is reported in the articles. The only dual-screening study is the US BRFSS analysis (Harper et al.), which reports dual cervical and CRC screening of 58.2% (57.1–59.4) among US women aged 50–64. A search for 'Basque' returned no hits in any article.

other_candidates.why_rejected: US BRFSS women 50–64, not the Basque Country FIT programme.

cases.answer: No. The HP2030 goals (cervical 84.3%, CRC 74.4%) are national targets for each cancer individually, cited as benchmarks. The study's own achieved rate was dual-screening in 58.2% of women, far below those goals.

cancer individually (HP2030 goals cervix: 84.3% and CRC: 74.4%)

cases.ambiguity: The 'Harper' citations include Harper et al. 2021a, an earlier Michigan study, but the HP2030 goals are still targets, not that study's rates.

cases.answer: The Hunan Cancer Hospital retrospective cohort (Dec 2018–Dec 2020) included 190 NSCLC patients: 69 received neoadjuvant PD-1 inhibitor plus chemotherapy and 121 chemotherapy alone. The surgical restriction is that only patients who actually underwent surgery after neoadjuvant therapy were included; patients who failed to undergo surgery for any reason were excluded. After PSM, 64 patients per group were analysed.
